description: Get the short reflection and one-line prayer Lamplight (https://lamplightverse.com) shows for a day’s verse, with the verse in the KJV (license: Public domain outside the United Kingdom). Reflections are written with help from AI tools and checked against each verse; the scripture itself is never AI-written. They change once a day, at midnight US Eastern. Pass date (YYYY-MM-DD) for yesterday, today or tomorrow. data_updated_at is the date of the verse.

date.description: Day to get, as YYYY-MM-DD. Only yesterday, today or tomorrow (US Eastern) are accepted, so a reader in any time zone can ask for their own day. Default: today, US Eastern.

name: todays_reflection
title: Reflection and prayer for the verse of the day
